podcast.body: This self-titled EP was the first release from the Epitaph label in 1981, a company established by the band themselves because no other label was interested in releasing their music. Initially, Epitaph served as a vehicle solely for Bad Religion's records. "The first release from the label was their self-titled EP in 1981."
